answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and propagate trust with random walks capped at \(k\) steps, keeping influence local. A sybil cluster joined to honest nodes by a sparse external cut has low conductance. Under suitable mixing assumptions, conductance and min-cut bounds limit walk mass entering the cluster, thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight regardless of identity count. mesa, delta, and violet can label candidate clusters; their weight depends on cut capacity, not headcount.
